definitions.explanation: A paper template used as a guide for cutting fabric when making clothes or other sewn items.

examples.japanese: {型紙|かたがみ}に{沿|そ}って{布|ぬの}を{切|き}った。
examples.english: I cut the fabric following the pattern.

examples.japanese: この{本|ほん}には{型紙|かたがみ}が{付|つ}いている。
examples.english: This book comes with patterns included.

examples.japanese: {自分|じぶん}で{型紙|かたがみ}を{作|つく}ってワンピースを{縫|ぬ}った。
examples.english: I made my own pattern and sewed a dress.

notes:
FORMATION:
{型|かた} (form/mold) + {紙|かみ}→がみ (paper)

Note: {紙|かみ} becomes {紙|がみ} (rendaku) in this compound.

USAGE:
・{型紙|かたがみ}を{写|うつ}す (to trace a pattern)
・{型紙|かたがみ}を{起|お}こす (to create a pattern)
・{型紙|かたがみ}を{当|あ}てる (to place a pattern on fabric)

ALTERNATIVE TERM:
・パターン (pattern - loanword, also commonly used)

CONTEXT:
Used in sewing, dressmaking, and craft projects. Professional patterns often come in standard sizes.
